citation.title: Effect of Titrating Positive End-Expiratory Pressure (PEEP) With an Esophageal Pressure–Guided Strategy vs an Empirical High PEEP-FIO2 Strategy on Death and Days Free From Mechanical Ventilation Among Patients With Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome

provenance.quote: Patients aged 16 years or older with moderate to severe ARDS (PaO2:FIO2 ≤200 mm Hg) onset within the last 36 hours were eligible for enrollment.
Two hundred mechanically ventilated patients aged 16 years and older with moderate to severe ARDS (PaO2:FIO2 ≤200 mm Hg) were enrolled
provenance.location: p. E1, Abstract, DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS

provenance.quote: This study was a multicenter randomized trial comparing PES-guided PEEP titration vs an empirical high PEEP-FIO2 titration table in patients with moderate to severe ARDS. The trial enrolled participants at 14 hospitals across the United States and Canada.

PEEP was evaluated at least once daily and adjusted as needed to maintain end-expiratory PL between 0 to 6 cm H2O, ensuring PEEP was never less than nor substantially more than pleural pressure estimated by PES.

Prespecified secondary clinical end points included all-cause mortality at 28 days, 60 days, and 1 year; ventilator-free days through day 28; intensive care unit (ICU) and hospital lengths of stay through day 28 and day 60; protocol failure requiring rescue therapy; and functional status at 1 year.
Two hundred patients were enrolled (mean [SD] age, 56 [16] years; 46% female) and completed 28-day follow-up.
Phase 2 randomized clinical trial conducted at 14 hospitals in North America.

subgroup_flags.classification_notes: ards_only: all patients met moderate-severe ARDS (Berlin) criteria at enrolment. obesity_subgroup unclear: BMI not reported (only predicted body weight and actual body weight). timing_subgroup early_within_48h: median time intubated prior to enrollment was 22 (13 to 31) h in the PES-guided group and balloon-guided titration began at enrollment, i.e. within ~48 h of intubation; reference event recorded as enrolment per codebook. ptp_target_subgroups: end-expiratory PL target 0-6 cm H2O via absolute Pes subtraction. is_longest_reported_mortality set on 1-year mortality (longest fixed-day follow-up).

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: COHORTS.md lists epvent2 as beitler_2019 (primary, JAMA, n=200) plus sarge_2021 (post hoc reanalysis of EPVent-2 including all 200 participants). Confirmed for this report: trial registration NCT01681225, enrolment October 31, 2012 to September 14, 2017, 14 centres in the US and Canada, n=200 analysed. This record is the primary report.
unclear_items: eligibility.criteria.adults_18_plus: trial enrolled patients aged 16 years and older, so a small minority may have been under 18; coded yes because the setting is adult ICUs and no age-stratified results are given.
intervention.device_brand: balloon catheter manufacturer not named in the main text (protocol published separately as Fish et al, BMJ Open 2014).

intervention.balloon_calibration.method: filling-volume calibration and occlusion testing not described in the main text; coded not_reported, position verification via core-laboratory quality control recorded.
design.blinding: not stated whether treating clinicians or outcome assessors were blinded; PL measurements were withheld from the treating team in the empirical arm.
population.bmi: not reported (predicted body weight and actual body weight reported instead).
feasibility.n_placement_attempted and n_placement_successful: derived from the single reported insertion failure; denominators not printed explicitly.
outcomes: respiratory physiological measures over days 1-7 are reported only in Figure 2 and eTable 2 (Supplement 2); numeric values would require digitisation or the supplement.
data_only_in_figure: Respiratory physiological measures from baseline through day 7 (PL at end-expiration and end-inspiration, set PEEP, plateau pressure, PES at end-expiration, PaO2:FIO2, airway driving pressure, transpulmonary driving pressure) — Figure 2 panels A-H
extraction_flags.general_notes: Primary composite end point is a ranked score (probabilistic index), not a conventional mean difference; recorded under domain 'other'. Days free from mechanical ventilation among survivors (survivors only) and ventilator-free days (deaths assigned 0) are distinct outcomes and recorded separately. Plasma biomarker results not reported in this paper. Functional status at 1 year reported in eAppendix 2 only. ICU length of stay at 60 days was not collected.
